measures.name: On Time Paid Amount
measures.expression: SUMX('FactInvoices', IF(IF((NOT ISBLANK(('FactInvoices'[Paid Flag] = TRUE())) && NOT(('FactInvoices'[Paid Flag] = TRUE()))) || (NOT ISBLANK(IF(ISBLANK('FactInvoices'[Payment Date]), BLANK(), ('FactInvoices'[Payment Date] <= 'FactInvoices'[Due Date]))) && NOT(IF(ISBLANK('FactInvoices'[Payment Date]), BLANK(), ('FactInvoices'[Payment Date] <= 'FactInvoices'[Due Date])))), FALSE(), IF(ISBLANK(('FactInvoices'[Paid Flag] = TRUE())) || ISBLANK(IF(ISBLANK('FactInvoices'[Payment Date]), BLANK(), ('FactInvoices'[Payment Date] <= 'FactInvoices'[Due Date]))), BLANK(), TRUE())), 'FactInvoices'[Invoice Amount], 0))

measures.name: Avg Days to Pay
measures.expression: AVERAGEX('FactInvoices', IF(ISBLANK('FactInvoices'[Payment Date]), BLANK(), DATEDIFF('FactInvoices'[Invoice Date], 'FactInvoices'[Payment Date], DAY)))

measures.name: Selected Metric Amount
measures.expression: SWITCH([Status Selector Value], "Late invoices", SUMX('FactInvoices', IF(('FactInvoices'[Payment Status] = "Late"), 'FactInvoices'[Invoice Amount])), "On time", [On Time Paid Amount], SUM('FactInvoices'[Invoice Amount]))

measures.name: Vendor Share of Region
measures.expression: DIVIDE(SUM('FactInvoices'[Invoice Amount]), CALCULATE(SUM('FactInvoices'[Invoice Amount]), ALLSELECTED('DimVendor'[Vendor Name])))

tables.name: FactInvoices
tables.m:
let
    Source = Sql.Database(#"Invoice Health Server", #"Invoice Health Database"),
    Data = Source{[Schema = "dbo", Item = "FactInvoices"]}[Data],
    Selected = Table.SelectColumns(Data, {"invoice_id", "vendor_key", "employee_key", "date_key", "invoice_date", "due_date", "payment_date", "invoice_amount", "status", "paid_flag"}, MissingField.UseNull),
    Renamed = Table.RenameColumns(Selected, {{"invoice_id", "Invoice ID"}, {"vendor_key", "Vendor Key"}, {"employee_key", "Employee Key"}, {"date_key", "Date Key"}, {"invoice_date", "Invoice Date"}, {"due_date", "Due Date"}, {"payment_date", "Payment Date"}, {"invoice_amount", "Invoice Amount"}, {"status", "Status"}, {"paid_flag", "Paid Flag"}}),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Renamed, {{"Invoice ID", type text}, {"Vendor Key", type text}, {"Employee Key", type text}, {"Date Key", Int64.Type}, {"Invoice Date", type date}, {"Due Date", type date}, {"Payment Date", type date}, {"Invoice Amount", type number}, {"Status", type text}, {"Paid Flag", type logical}})
in
    Typed

columns.name: Days Late
columns.expression: IF(ISBLANK('FactInvoices'[Payment Date]), BLANK(), DATEDIFF('FactInvoices'[Due Date], 'FactInvoices'[Payment Date], DAY))

columns.name: Payment Status
columns.expression:
SWITCH(TRUE(),
        ISBLANK('FactInvoices'[Payment Date]), "Unpaid",
        IF(ISBLANK('FactInvoices'[Payment Date]), BLANK(), ('FactInvoices'[Payment Date] <= 'FactInvoices'[Due Date])), "On time",
        "Late"
    )

columns.name: Aging Bucket
columns.expression:
SWITCH(TRUE(),
        ISBLANK('FactInvoices'[Payment Date]), "Unpaid",
        IF(ISBLANK('FactInvoices'[Days Late]), BLANK(), ('FactInvoices'[Days Late] <= 0)), "Not late",
        IF(ISBLANK('FactInvoices'[Days Late]), BLANK(), ('FactInvoices'[Days Late] <= 15)), "1-15 days",
        IF(ISBLANK('FactInvoices'[Days Late]), BLANK(), ('FactInvoices'[Days Late] <= 30)), "16-30 days",
        "30+ days"
    )

columns.name: Vendor Fixed Amount
columns.expression: (VAR __lod1 = RELATED('DimVendor'[Vendor Name]) RETURN CALCULATE(SUM('FactInvoices'[Invoice Amount]), REMOVEFILTERS(), 'DimVendor'[Vendor Name] = __lod1))
